source: docs/12-real-scenario-target.md, corrected and extended by the owner on 2026-10-22 (the row key is Transaction String; the identifying cell is clicked on Monthly Actuals; the match is in column B of the transactions sheet and the amount is taken from its column C; the work repeats per transaction; Variance is a formula). G10 (the total requires Status = 'Paid', which nothing in the recording sets) was added after the owner confirmed on 2026-10-22 that setting Status is not in the video.
note: Each finding passes if ANY group passes (a line matching a finding's optional 'exclude' patterns never counts for it); a group passes if EVERY pattern matches within one line of sop.md (case-insensitive). The patterns are scenario facts, so they live here and never in prompts or pipeline code. A pattern hit is evidence that a finding was surfaced, not proof it was surfaced correctly: read the matching lines. 'forbidden' lists claims already seen to be false in real runs.

findings.name: 'master files' is the Master Bills sheet, the reference list, not where the work happens
'monthly actions' is the Monthly Actuals sheet, where the work happens
'transactions' is the Transactions - March sheet, the third sheet compared against
the row is identified by its Transaction String (the cell clicked on Monthly Actuals), not by Bill ID, which repeats
that string is searched for in column B of the transactions sheet
the value taken is the Actualized Amount in column C of the matching row
the paste target is column F (Actual) of the same row
the process repeats for every other transaction in the period; only one is shown
Variance is a formula that calculates the difference and must not be overwritten
the total counts a row only where Status is 'Paid', and nothing in the recording sets it

forbidden.why: 235,000 is the real billed total shown on screen, so the number is not invented (owner, 2026-10-22). The error is calling it the total the pasted actual value contributes to; the total that updates is the actualized one
invented in a real run: a misread of a February row's Expected and Actual values
